description: Derive a Petri-net model from source code with the configured LLM (control flow, state machine, resources or concurrency focus), validate it, and store it as a NEW model you own. Runs generator.CodeToFlow directly — this tool is its only surface on sim.pflow.xyz, which mounts no code-to-flow HTTP endpoint; refused when this deployment has no LLM provider configured. Returns the new id when the answer validates, otherwise the raw model JSON and the validation errors so you can fix and sim_create_model it by hand.

language.description: source language hint, e.g. go, python, javascript

name: sim_code_to_flow
